featuresPage.title: Pagayo Features - Webshop, POS, WhatsApp and QR in one platform
featuresPage.description: Discover all Pagayo features for e-commerce and hospitality: order management, inventory, coupons, returns, subscriptions, analytics and omnichannel sales in one dashboard.
featuresPage.intro: From webshop and POS to WhatsApp, QR and subscriptions, Pagayo centralizes orders, inventory, payments, coupons, returns and reporting in one clear platform.

points.title: Order-First core
points.description: All channels flow into one consistent order lifecycle with shared statuses, shared actions and shared reporting.

points.title: Real-time operations
points.description: Inventory, low-stock alerts, returns, membership validation and coupon usage stay visible to your team in real time.

points.title: Scale without re-platforming
points.description: Start free, add modules when needed, and grow internationally without stitching together separate tools.

blogPage.title: Pagayo Blog — Commerce, edge engineering, and platform notes
blogPage.description: Articles from the Pagayo team on edge-native commerce, SSR hydration, payments, and building a platform that runs everywhere.
blogPage.headline: Ideas for building commerce on the edge.
blogPage.intro: Engineering notes, product thinking, and industry perspectives from the team behind Pagayo — the platform where every sale is one Order.

changelogPage.title: Pagayo Changelog — Product updates and fixes
changelogPage.description: A dated log of what changed in Pagayo: new features, improvements, fixes, and removals — from the first commit to today.
changelogPage.headline: What shipped, and when.
changelogPage.intro: Product-facing changes to Pagayo — new capabilities, improvements, and fixes. For the week-by-week build story, see the Build Log.

successStoriesPage.title: Pagayo Success Stories — Operators in the wild
successStoriesPage.description: One hundred anonymised stories from shops, clubs, foundations, and independent operators across Stripe-supported regions — grouped by continent.
successStoriesPage.headline: Built for operators who run the show.
successStoriesPage.intro: One hundred success stories from Pagayo tenants across continents where Stripe is active — from webshops and gyms to foundations, pools, and clubs. Stories are grouped by region, not by country list. We never name tenants or their organisations: only the role they play and the city they operate in.
